category_title: Low-achieving male vocational students with a preference for digital tasks over traditional writing
minimal_context: The student is using Photoshop to design a laptop flyer for a regular class assignment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open Photoshop and start working on your regular assignment to design a laptop flyer.

STUDENT: There are too many menus and tools in this program. This looks really difficult to achieve.

TUTOR: Just give it a try and see what you can do.

STUDENT: I don't know how to make it look right. These regular assignments make me get bored very quickly.

TUTOR: Keep trying, you need to finish the flyer today.

STUDENT: (Closes the program) I'm not doing this. It's too difficult and I'm bored, so I'm just not going to participate.

options.A: Simplify the flyer assignment, reduce the overall requirements, summarize the steps, and simplify the design work.
options.B: Call a staff member to walk the student outside, not allowing them to return until they are calm.
options.C: Allow the use of labels in English, Chinese characters, and pinyin for the laptop flyer design.
options.D: Suggest that if the student feels angry, they can walk out and get a drink of water.
